description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Civil Procedure Code Notification under Section 192
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification from the Central Bank of Sri Lanka setting the legal rate of interest under the Civil Procedure Code. It involves a regulatory matter (interest rate determination) based on statutory authority (Monetary Law Act and Civil Procedure Code amendments), making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it names an individual (Nivard Cabraal), the primary purpose is to announce a regulatory decision, not a government personnel change or portfolio assignment.
